subject: english
stem: Claim: A checklist helps people remember multi-step tasks. Which example is too weak?
options: A camper used a list and packed all required items.
A student marked completed steps and submitted every part.
A checklist was printed on yellow paper.
A nurse checked every step and missed none.

optionRationales.reason: A camper used a list and packed all required items.：支持。
A student marked completed steps and submitted every part.：支持。
A checklist was printed on yellow paper.：只有物件外觀，無 remember/task outcome。
A nurse checked every step and missed none.：支持。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「例子必須具備主張中的關鍵條件，且結果方向能作為該主張的具體個案」可推出 A checklist was printed on yellow paper.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 A checklist was printed on yellow paper. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
